posts.body_html:
I had ordered many plants over the winter from various company's and individuals, most were multiple plant orders like my order from Mike. All other growers sent stuff with a 60-80% success rate/non rotting at my doorstep, coupled with bugs and other junk. That being said, I had hoped Mike would be different seeing all these reviews. Long story short, these reviews are all praising his work and rightfully so. In the email communication he was extremely friendly and helpful. 100% of the plants arrived in EXCELLENT condition and all were super healthy. Some of them are opening pitchers and looking incredible. I wish Mike was in NC so I could buy his whole Oreophila collection lol. I look at mikes list every time I think about ordering a plant, because I know I will get something healthy and amazing.

Thank you Mike for all you do for this community!

I’m a VFT, Drosera, Nepenthes, & Heliamphora guy but I was recently drawn to Sarracenias after hearing about Mike Wang’s Sarracenia ‘Ellie Wang’ through Jeremiah Harris. I’m glad I emailed Mike and purchased my first ever set of sarracenia from him because he is amazing!

He is a wealth of knowledge and a great communicator. His collection is vast and has pretty much every variant you could ever dream of. If you’re ever looking for a specific plant, just ask. He probably has it.

I never purchase without using a 3rd party like Ebay but Mike has a long track record so I was comfortable buying directly from him. My purchase went through smoothly and arrived quickly. Every plant arrived in excellent condition, nice size, lots of traps & healthy roots. He also added some extras, which I honestly would’ve paid for because they were absolutely stunning. He’s my go-to Sarracenia guy, great vendor!
